name: VITROX
recent: ViTrox 在 2026 财年第三季度录得上市以来最佳季度业绩，营收 4.851 亿令吉，净利 1.186 亿令吉，主要受 AI 相关需求带动。不过，多家董事与高管在 9 月至 10 月期间持续减持股份，公司也因员工股份授予计划（SGS）发行新股。
notable: 2026 财年第三季度营收 4.851 亿令吉，净利 1.186 亿令吉，为上市以来最佳季度。
多名董事及高管在 9 月至 10 月期间于公开市场减持股份。
公司根据员工股份授予计划（SGS）发行 82,500 股新股，并于 2026 年 10 月 8 日上市。
risks: 董事及高管在近期持续减持公司股份。
有新闻报导指供应链瓶颈可能影响增长。
员工股份授予计划（SGS）持续发行新股，对股本造成轻微摊薄。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 4.851 亿令吉，环比增长 29.4%，同比增长 165.0%；净利为 1.186 亿令吉，环比增长 39.4%，同比增长 321.5%；净利率为 24.4%，高于上一季度的 22.7%。

recent_en: ViTrox posted its best quarterly results since listing in Q3 FY2026, with revenue of RM485.1 million and net profit of RM118.6 million, driven mainly by AI-related demand. However, several directors and senior management continued to dispose of shares between September and October, and the company issued new shares under its Employees Share Grant Scheme (SGS).
notable_en: Q3 FY2026 revenue was RM485.1 million and net profit was RM118.6 million, the best quarter since listing.
Several directors and senior management disposed of shares in the open market between September and October.
The company issued 82,500 new shares under its Employees Share Grant Scheme (SGS), listed on 8 October 2026.
risks_en: Directors and senior management have continued to dispose of shares recently.
News reports indicate that supply chain bottlenecks may affect growth.
The Employees Share Grant Scheme (SGS) continues to issue new shares, causing slight dilution to share capital.
earnings_en: Q3 FY2026 revenue was RM485.1 million, up 29.4% QoQ and 165.0% YoY; net profit was RM118.6 million, up 39.4% QoQ and 321.5% YoY; net margin was 24.4%, higher than 22.7% in the previous quarter.
